name: Azure Application Gateway - Health
description: Azure Application Gateway - Health dashboard provides details like recent alerts, resource health incidents, recent resource health status by resource name, trend by event type, downtime by causes, trend of unavailable, degraded,  available etc.
title: Azure Application Gateway - Health

queries.queryString:
tenant_name={{tenant_name}} subscription_id={{subscription_id}} resource_group={{resource_group}} resource_type={{resource_type}} provider_name={{provider_name}} resource_name={{resource_name}} ResourceHealth Downtime
| JSON "category", "properties.type", "properties.cause" as category, type, cause
| where category="ResourceHealth" and type="Downtime"
| count as Count by cause
| sort by Count, cause asc

queries.queryString:
tenant_name={{tenant_name}} subscription_id={{subscription_id}} resource_group={{resource_group}} resource_type={{resource_type}} provider_name={{provider_name}} resource_name={{resource_name}} ResourceHealth
| JSON "category", "properties.currentHealthStatus" as category, currentHealthStatus
| where category="ResourceHealth"
| -1 as current_health_status
| if (currentHealthStatus =="Unavailable", 0, current_health_status) as current_health_status
| if (currentHealthStatus =="Degraded", 1, current_health_status) as current_health_status
| if (currentHealthStatus =="Available", 2, current_health_status) as current_health_status
| where current_health_status!=-1
| timeslice 1h
| withtime current_health_status 
| most_recent(current_health_status_withtime) as current_health_status by resource_name, _timeslice
| number(current_health_status) as current_health_status
| transpose row _timeslice column resource_name

panels.title: Recent Resource Health Status by Resource Name

queries.queryString:
tenant_name={{tenant_name}} subscription_id={{subscription_id}} resource_group={{resource_group}} resource_type={{resource_type}} provider_name={{provider_name}} resource_name={{resource_name}} ResourceHealth
| JSON "category", "properties.currentHealthStatus" as category, currentHealthStatus
| where category="ResourceHealth"
| withtime currentHealthStatus
| most_recent(currentHealthStatus_withtime) as currentHealthStatus by resource_name

tenant_name={{tenant_name}} subscription_id={{subscription_id}}  Alert
| JSON "category", "resultType", "properties.eventTimestamp", "properties.operationName", "properties.status", "properties.resourceId" as category, resultType, eventTimestamp, operationName, status, resourceId
| resource_name as alert_name
| toUpperCase(resourceId) as resourceId
| parse field=resourceId "/RESOURCEGROUPS/*/" as resource_group nodrop
| parse regex field=resourceId "/PROVIDERS/(?<provider_name>[^/]+)" nodrop
| parse regex field=resourceId "/PROVIDERS/[^/]+(?:/LOCATIONS/[^/]+)?/(?<resource_type>[^/]+)/(?<resource_name>.+)" nodrop
| where if (resource_group=="*", true, resource_group matches "{{resource_group}}")
| where if(resource_type=="*", true, resource_type matches "{{resource_type}}") 
| where if(resource_name=="*", true, resource_name matches "{{resource_name}}")
| where category="Alert"
| parse field=operationName "*/*/*" as category, operation_name, action nodrop
| count as Count by resourceId,level, resultType, alert_name, resource_name, provider_name, operation_name, eventTimestamp, status

tenant_name={{tenant_name}} subscription_id={{subscription_id}} resource_group={{resource_group}} resource_type={{resource_type}} provider_name={{provider_name}} resource_name={{resource_name}} ResourceHealth
| JSON "category", "properties.currentHealthStatus" as category, currentHealthStatus
| where category="ResourceHealth"
| count as Count by currentHealthStatus

tenant_name={{tenant_name}} subscription_id={{subscription_id}} resource_group={{resource_group}} resource_type={{resource_type}} provider_name={{provider_name}} resource_name={{resource_name}} ResourceHealth
| JSON "category", "operationName", "time","level","resultType", "properties.title", "properties.details", "properties.currentHealthStatus", "properties.type", "properties.cause" as category, operationName, time,level,resultType, title, details, currentHealthStatus, type, cause nodrop
| where category="ResourceHealth"
| parse field=operationName "*/*/*" as category, operation_name, action nodrop
| count as Count by time, level, resultType, resource_name, operation_name, title, details, currentHealthStatus, type, cause
